title: Pixlar O Ljud Live #1
intro: A real-time audiovisual performance descending from the ocean surface into bioluminescent depths.

content: A real-time audiovisual performance developed in {link:https://derivative.ca/}TouchDesigner{/link}, unfolding as a descent beneath the ocean surface. It begins with gentle waves and a drifting buoy, then dives into vibrant underwater ecosystems. Layer upon layer of audio-reactive effects accumulate, and the recognizable scene gradually dissolves into complex, abstract patterns. Live manipulation of system parameters and sensitivity thresholds brings improvisation into the process, making the performance a unique dialogue between sound, motion, and emergence.
Performed at {link:https://www.musikcentrumsyd.se/nyheter/pixlar-och-ljud-p-hypnos}Pixlar Och Ljud Live{/link}, {link:https://hypnostheatre.com/}Hypnos Theater{/link}, June 2026.
